Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_Return: Return an empty capsule after unpacking
When on, the player who threw the capsule gets an empty capsule back after the vehicle appears, ready to pack another vehicle.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_PackPe:
With Minidoracat Vehicle Manager installed, only the owner can pack a claimed vehicle (admins need its override on); this option covers unclaimed vehicles.
Key holders: the player carries this vehicle's key, or the key is in the ignition.
Anyone: every player can pack.
Admins only: regular players cannot pack.
Admins can always pack, whatever this option says.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_Zombie: Zombie attraction radius of the capsule sound (tiles)
0 to 50 tiles. 0 means the capsule popping open does not attract zombies.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_LootEn:
Master switch: when off, none of the four locations below spawn empty capsules.
Only affects containers opened for the first time afterwards; containers already looted do not respawn.
Sandbox_MinidoracatVehicleCapsule_LootMe: 0 to 10, the same scale as vanilla loot table weights. Higher means more common.
